proposed_change: Use existing live occupancy/arrival reservations when selecting among existing supported native-reachable food stances, keep exact native container reach/body/pickup receipts. Extend existing bounded cached supply debug withCOBBLESTONE/store and matching upkeep worker requests before truncation. No new item source, inventory scan budget, price, reward, capacity, permission or collider rule. If confirmed that requested-input routing only accepts warehouses, allow existing producer output stock to fulfill the same accepted native input request through ordinary cargo transfer and existing output/input slot roles, source availability, destination capacity and journal checks. No warehouse expansion, item deletion, teleport or free materials. Living-worker container/ground pickup uses the same full-body/hazard/liquid/nine-sample support checks with existing packet .13 tolerance; corpse placement/resurrection retain .02. Retain already reachable actual food pickup before selecting another occupied-side alternative. No ray/collision/quantity/quota relaxation.
